china-cloud-retry.research_notes:
METHOD / LIMITATIONS: The sandbox egress proxy returned CONNECT 403 for every relevant domain (www.sec.gov, efts.sec.gov, alibabagroup.com, ir.baidu.com, tencent.com, prnewswire, businesswire, Reuters, Yahoo, etc.), so NO direct document fetches were possible. Per fallback instructions, every figure was taken from search-engine renderings of the underlying primary documents (company press releases on Business Wire/PR Newswire, SEC 6-K/20-F exhibits, and earnings-call transcript summaries), cross-checked across at least two independent queries/outlets per company. Quotes are verbatim as rendered by search results; a few (flagged in-line) are rendering paraphrases rather than press-release text. Confidence in the headline segment revenue/EBITA numbers is high because identical figures appeared across 3+ independent renderings of the official releases.

REPORTING CALENDAR (as of Sun/Mon Aug 17, 2026): Tencent Q2 2026 reported Aug 12, 2026 (used). Baidu Q2 2026 due pre-market Aug 18, 2026 - one day after cutoff - so Q1 2026 (reported May 18, 2026) used; re-extract after Aug 18. Alibaba June-2026 quarter (fiscal Q1 FY2027) not yet reported (sources cite Aug 20 or Aug 29, 2026; street expects ~$35.3bn group revenue), so March-2026 quarter / FY2026 results (reported May 13, 2026) used.

FX: All my own conversions use 7.1 RMB/USD as instructed. Note the companies' own releases imply ~6.90 RMB/USD (e.g., Alibaba RMB41,626m = US$6,035m; Baidu RMB279.3bn = US$40.49bn), so company-published USD figures are ~3% higher than my 7.1-based conversions.

KEY CROSS-COMPANY FACTS: (1) Alibaba Cloud is the only one of the three with a disclosed segment profit metric (adjusted EBITA RMB3,796m in Mar-26 quarter, +57%; FY26 RMB14,265m, +35%) - note EBITA is not EBITDA. (2) Baidu re-segmented AI Cloud into 'AI Cloud Infra' (RMB8.8bn, +79%) + 'AI Applications' (RMB2.5bn, flat), total RMB11.3bn; the widely quoted +79% is Infra-only. (3) Tencent discloses no cloud revenue line at all - FinTech & Business Services (RMB60.3bn, +9%) is the container; cloud growth was stated qualitatively as accelerating from 'high teens' (Q1) to 'low 20s' percent YoY (Q2), with international cloud +40%. (4) AI capex arms race confirmed in official numbers: Alibaba FY26 capex RMB126.1bn with FY26 FCF at -RMB46.6bn and management signaling overshoot of the RMB380bn 3-yr plan (reports of ~RMB480bn under consideration, per DCD - unconfirmed by company); Tencent 2Q26 operating capex RMB51.8bn (+190% YoY) flipping quarterly FCF to -RMB13.8bn and cutting its net cash from RMB146.9bn to RMB58.2bn in one quarter; Baidu discloses no numeric capex, only 'strategic investment intensity' language, and its Q1 operating cash flow was just RMB2.7bn vs RMB279.3bn total cash & investments. (5) MW/GW/GPU-count capacity disclosure: none for any of the three - nulls are correct, documented per company; the only capacity-flavored remarks were Tencent's 'sufficient GPU ASIC capacity' comment and Alibaba's capex-plan language. (6) Net cash: Alibaba ~US$37bn net cash (company cash US$75.5bn minus aggregator-sourced debt US$38.4bn - the only third-party-sourced number used in a calculation); Tencent company-defined net cash RMB58.2bn; Baidu left null (gross cash US$40.49bn verified, debt not verifiable from renderings, clearly net cash overall). Valuation fields null for all three - unlisted segments of listed parents.
